questions: How many ATQG devices did you fabricate and measure, and how many showed the superconductivity and the D-tunable critical current? The paper shows one device, at 1.58°.
Why were the others set aside, or was this the only device that worked?
Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown, for example Landau fans at D ≠ 0 or below 1.7 K, and critical current maps versus D at fillings other than νtot = 2.31?
What does the second-best dataset look like, for example the D-Idc map and the Landau fan from another contact pair in Supp. Fig. 1?

Which contact pair, temperature and cooldown are Fig. 5a and 5c from, and what width did you use to turn Idc into js and jn? Supp. Fig. 7a (ν = 2.31, 100 mK) shows a switching edge near 50 nA at D = 0, about half the value in Fig. 5c.
In Fig. 5c, does the switching-current peak near D ≈ 0.25 V/nm sit where a finite-bias dV/dI ridge meets the switching edge, and how does Fig. 5d change if that region is set aside?
What criterion sets Bc at each temperature in Supp. Fig. 2b, and how far do ξ × kF in Fig. 3c and 4c move with the Tc and Bc criteria (30 to 50%) and with n* taken as |νflat − 2| or from nH?

The universal BKT relation gives Ds(TBKT) = 8e²kBTBKT/(πħ²), about 1.3 × 10^8 H^-1 for TBKT = 1.6 K by my estimate, above the roughly 4 × 10^7 H^-1 in Fig. 5d. How do these two estimates of the stiffness compare in your analysis?
